name: primary
description: Packages for running GruntJS tasks for better developer experience when building or contributing to Primary for Obsidian. Primary is an intricate, polished, comfy color palette for various apps.
author: Cecilia May

scripts.sass: npm run sass-unminified && npm run sass-minified
scripts.concat: concat -o theme.css src/css/readme.css src/css/fonts/*.css src/css/main.min.css src/css/style-settings.css
scripts.publish: npm run sass && npm run concat && npm run copy-paste
